headline: Textron Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
summary: PROVIDENCE, R.I., July 28, 2026--Textron Inc. (NYSE: TXT) today reported second quarter 2026 net income of $1.42 per share, compared to $1.35 in the second quarter of 2025. Adjusted net income, a non-GAAP measure that is defined and reconciled to GAAP in an attachment to this release, was $1.62 per share for the second quarter of 2026, compared to $1.55 per share in the second quarter of 2025.
